/speech-to-text-realtime/ws.description:
WebSocket channel for real-time speech to text streaming powered by the
`saaras:v3-realtime` (default) or `saaras:v4` model.

**Authentication:** Pass your API subscription key via the
`API-SUBSCRIPTION-KEY` header, or (in browsers) via the WebSocket
subprotocol `api-subscription-key.<key>` — the server echoes the
subprotocol back.

**Note:** This API Reference page is provided for informational purposes only.
The Try It playground may not provide the best experience for streaming audio.
For optimal streaming performance, please use the SDK or implement your own WebSocket client.

/text-to-speech/ws.description:
WebSocket channel for real-time TTS synthesis.

**Note:** This API Reference page is provided for informational purposes only. 
The Try It playground may not provide the best experience for streaming audio. 
For optimal streaming performance, please use the SDK or implement your own WebSocket client.

**Model-Specific Notes:**
- **bulbul:v2:** Supports pitch, loudness, pace (0.3-3.0). Default sample rate: 22050 Hz.
- **bulbul:v3:** Does NOT support pitch/loudness. Pace range: 0.5-2.0. Supports temperature parameter (0.01–1.0). Default sample rate: 22050 Hz when `speech_sample_rate` is omitted. Preprocessing is always enabled.
- **bulbul:v4-flash:** Same request/response contract as bulbul:v3, with 200+ persona voices. Default sample rate: 22050 Hz when omitted.

/voices/clone/ws.description:
**Beta.** WebSocket channel for real-time Instant Voice Cloning synthesis.

Protocol matches Bulbul TTS WebSocket: send `config` once with exactly one
of a saved `voice_id` or base64 `ref_audio` (optional `ref_text`), then
incremental `text` and `flush` messages. The server streams base64 `audio`
frames and a `final` event.

**Note:** This API Reference page is provided for informational purposes only.
The Try It playground may not provide the best experience for streaming audio.
For optimal streaming performance, please use the SDK or implement your own WebSocket client.

**Auth:** send your key in the `api-subscription-key` header, or as a
WebSocket subprotocol `api-subscription-key.<key>`.

**Streaming codecs:** `mp3` (default), `wav`, `linear16`, `mulaw`, `alaw`.
`flac`, `aac`, and `opus` are not supported.

Quality checks (QC/VAD) and duration bounds are not accepted on this path.

/speech-to-text/ws.description:
WebSocket channel for real-time speech to text streaming.

**Note:** This API Reference page is provided for informational purposes only.

For optimal streaming performance, please use the SDK or implement your own WebSocket client.

speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_language_c.description:
BCP-47 language code of the input audio. **Required.**

**Supported languages (saaras:v3-realtime and saaras:v4):**
- `auto`: Adaptive automatic language detection
- `en-IN`: English
- `hi-IN`: Hindi
- `bn-IN`: Bengali
- `kn-IN`: Kannada
- `ml-IN`: Malayalam
- `mr-IN`: Marathi
- `or-IN`: Odia
- `pa-IN`: Punjabi
- `ta-IN`: Tamil
- `te-IN`: Telugu
- `gu-IN`: Gujarati
- `as-IN`: Assamese
- `ur-IN`: Urdu
- `ne-IN`: Nepali
- `kok-IN`: Konkani
- `ks-IN`: Kashmiri
- `sd-IN`: Sindhi
- `sa-IN`: Sanskrit
- `sat-IN`: Santali
- `mni-IN`: Manipuri
- `brx-IN`: Bodo
- `mai-IN`: Maithili
- `doi-IN`: Dogri
speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_language_c.title: speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_language_code

speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_model.description: Speech-to-text model for this endpoint. `saaras:v3-realtime` (default) or `saaras:v4`.
speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_model.title: speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_model

speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_stream_typ.description:
Controls audio chunking and latency behaviour.

- **fast**: Partials at low latency.
- **balanced** (default): Partials with better accuracy.
- **simulated**: No partials.
speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_stream_typ.title: speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_stream_type

speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_mode.description:
Task applied on the final transcript, not on partial transcripts.
Streaming partials are always straight transcription regardless of
this value.

- **transcribe** (default): Standard transcription in the source language script.
- **translate**: Translation to English.
- **verbatim**: Exact transcription in the original script (includes disfluencies).
- **translit**: Transliteration to Latin script.
- **codemix**: Code-mixed output (native + English).
speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_mode.title: speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_mode

speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_endpointin.description:
Turn detection strategy.

- **vad** (default): Voice Activity Detection automatically detects turn boundaries.
- **manual**: The client delimits turns with `speech_start` / `speech_end` events.
speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_endpointin.title: speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_endpointing

speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_encoding.description: Audio encoding of the input stream. **Mono only.**
speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_encoding.title: speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_encoding

speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_sample_rat.description:
Audio sample rate in Hz. Must match the actual audio.

**Accepted values:**
- `8000`
- `16000` (default)

Any other value closes the connection with code `4000`.
speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_sample_rat.title: speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_sample_rate

speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_return_tim.description:
When `true`, adds segment-level `start_s` / `end_s` audio-time offsets

speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_return_tim.title: speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_return_timestamps

is_fatal.description: Whether the error is fatal (the connection will be closed)

status_code.description:
HTTP-equivalent status code, present on fatal rejections
(e.g. `401`, `403`, `503`, `400`, `408`, `413`, `500`). Useful
because the WebSocket close reason string is capped at 123 bytes.

speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_realtimeEr.description:
Non-fatal or fatal error notification. The wire payload always carries
`event`, `code`, `is_fatal`, and `message`, plus an optional
`status_code` on fatal rejections.

**WebSocket close codes:**
- `1003`: Rate limit exceeded, quota exhausted, or invalid subscription key.
- `1008`: Inactivity timeout.
- `1011`: Internal server error.
- `4000`: Application rejection (beta denied, invalid model, unsupported `language_code` / query param, gRPC backend unavailable). The close reason string is capped at 123 bytes.

**Known error codes:**
- `invalid_config` (non-fatal): A `config.update` value was rejected (e.g. changing `stream_type` to/from `simulated`). The session continues with the previous config.
speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_realtimeEr.title: speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_realtimeError

ChannelsSpeechToTextRealtimeStreamingMes.title: ChannelsSpeechToTextRealtimeStreamingMessagesRealtimeConfigUpdateStreamType

language_code.description: Re-arms auto-LID and resets the sticky language. Boundary-gated.

prompt.description: Non-streaming context hint (empty string clears it). Boundary-gated.

stream_type.description: `fast`↔`balanced` swap. Boundary-gated. Changing to/from `simulated` is rejected.

threshold.title: float
threshold.description: VAD activation threshold; applied immediately (vad only).

min_speech_duration_ms.description: Minimum speech duration; applied immediately (vad only).

speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_realtimeCo.description:
Updates session config mid-stream. `language_code`, `mode`, `prompt`,
`stream_type`, and `endpointing` are boundary-gated: validated on arrival
but deferred and applied at the next utterance boundary while an utterance
is in progress, so each utterance's partials and final use one consistent
config snapshot. The VAD detector knobs (`threshold`,
`silence_duration_ms`, `min_speech_duration_ms`) apply immediately on the
next VAD rebuild and are ignored under `endpointing=manual`. Changing
`stream_type` to/from `simulated` is rejected (`invalid_config`).

The server replies with `config.updated` (listing the applied keys), or an
`error` with code `invalid_config` on a rejected value.
speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_realtimeCo.title: speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_realtimeConfigUpdate

speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_realtimeEn.description:
Gracefully ends the session. The server finalizes any pending utterance
and closes the connection.
speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_realtimeEn.title: speechToTextRealtimeStreaming_realtimeEnd

pitch.description:
Controls the pitch of the audio. Lower values result in a deeper voice, 
while higher values make it sharper. The suitable range is between -0.75 
and 0.75. Default is 0.0.

**Note:** NOT supported for bulbul:v3 or bulbul:v4-flash. Will be ignored if provided.

pace.description:
Controls the speed of the audio. Lower values result in slower speech, 
while higher values make it faster. Default is 1.0.

**Model-specific ranges:**
- **bulbul:v2:** 0.3 to 3.0
- **bulbul:v3:** 0.5 to 2.0
- **bulbul:v4-flash:** 0.5 to 2.0

loudness.description:
Controls the loudness of the audio. Lower values result in quieter audio, 
while higher values make it louder. The suitable range is between 0.3 
and 3.0. Default is 1.0.

**Note:** NOT supported for bulbul:v3 or bulbul:v4-flash. Will be ignored if provided.

temperature.description:
Controls the randomness of the output. Lower values make the output more 
focused and deterministic, while higher values make it more random. 
The suitable range is between 0.01 and 1.0. Default is 0.6.

**Note:** Only supported for bulbul:v3 and bulbul:v4-flash. Will be ignored for bulbul:v2.

speech_sample_rate.description:
Specifies the sample rate of the output audio. Supported values are 
8000, 16000, 22050, 24000 Hz.

**Default when omitted:** 22050 Hz for all models (`bulbul:v2`, `bulbul:v3`, and `bulbul:v4-flash`).

enable_preprocessing.description:
Controls whether normalization of English words and numeric entities 
(e.g., numbers, dates) is performed. Set to true for better handling 
of mixed-language text.

**Model-specific defaults:**
- **bulbul:v2:** false (optional)
- **bulbul:v3:** Always enabled (cannot be disabled)
- **bulbul:v4-flash:** Always enabled (cannot be disabled)

output_audio_codec.description: Audio codec (currently supports MP3 only, optimized for real-time playback)

output_audio_bitrate.description: Audio bitrate (choose from 5 supported bitrate options)

dict_id.description:
The ID of a pronunciation dictionary to apply during synthesis. 
When provided, matching words in the input text will be replaced 
with their custom pronunciations before generating speech.

Create and manage dictionaries via the `/text-to-speech/pronunciation-dictionary` endpoints.

**Note:** Only supported by **bulbul:v3** and **bulbul:v4-flash**.

min_buffer_size.description: Minimum character length that triggers buffer flushing for TTS model processing

max_chunk_length.description: Maximum length for sentence splitting (adjust based on content length)

textToSpeechStreaming_ConfigureConnectio.description:
Configuration message required as the first message after establishing the WebSocket connection. 
This initializes TTS parameters and can be updated at any time during the WebSocket lifecycle 
by sending a new config message. When a config update is sent, any text currently in the buffer 
will be automatically flushed and processed before applying the new configuration.

**Model-Specific Notes:**
- **bulbul:v2:** Supports pitch, loudness, pace (0.3-3.0). Default sample rate: 22050 Hz.
- **bulbul:v3:** Does NOT support pitch/loudness. Pace range: 0.5-2.0. Supports temperature (0.01–1.0). Default sample rate: 22050 Hz when omitted.
- **bulbul:v4-flash:** Same request/response contract as bulbul:v3, with 200+ persona voices. Default sample rate: 22050 Hz when omitted.
textToSpeechStreaming_ConfigureConnectio.title: textToSpeechStreaming_ConfigureConnection

textToSpeechStreaming_FlushSignal.description:
Forces the text buffer to process immediately, regardless of the min_buffer_size threshold. 
Use this when you need to process remaining text that hasn't reached the minimum buffer size.
textToSpeechStreaming_FlushSignal.title: textToSpeechStreaming_FlushSignal

target_language_code.description:
BCP-47 language code for the synthesized output. The cloned voice can speak any

voice_id.description:
Cloned voice ID (`svc-{uuid}`) from your voice library. Create one with
`POST /voices/create`. Exactly one of `voice_id` or `ref_audio` must be provided.

ref_audio.description:
Base64-encoded reference audio clip (WAV recommended; also MP3, FLAC, OPUS, AAC,
MULAW, ALAW, LINEAR16). Max 10 MB decoded size and 15 seconds. Exactly one of
`voice_id` or `ref_audio` must be provided.

ref_text.description:
Optional transcript of `ref_audio` (max 500 characters). Improves fidelity.
Omit to let the API transcribe the clip. Ignored when `voice_id` is used.

enable_pretts.description:
Pre-TTS text normalization: numbers, currencies and dates converted to spoken
form before synthesis. Defaults to the server-side setting.

output_audio_codec.description:

Allowed: `mp3`, `wav`, `linear16`, `mulaw`, `alaw`.

output_audio_bitrate.description: Bitrate for lossy codecs. Default is `128k`.

min_buffer_size.description: Minimum character length that triggers buffer flushing for synthesis.

voiceCloningStreaming_VoiceCloningConfig.description:
Configuration message required as the first message after establishing the WebSocket connection.
Pass the target language and **exactly one** of `voice_id` (saved voice) or `ref_audio`
(base64 reference clip). Optional `ref_text` improves fidelity when using `ref_audio`.
Sending both `voice_id` and `ref_audio` returns an error. Duration bounds, QC, and VAD
are not accepted on this path.

speechToTextStreaming_language-code.description:
Specifies the language of the input audio in BCP-47 format.

**Available Options:**
- `unknown` (default): Use when the language is not known; the API will auto-detect.
- `hi-IN`: Hindi
- `bn-IN`: Bengali
- `gu-IN`: Gujarati
- `kn-IN`: Kannada
- `ml-IN`: Malayalam
- `mr-IN`: Marathi
- `od-IN`: Odia
- `pa-IN`: Punjabi
- `ta-IN`: Tamil
- `te-IN`: Telugu
- `en-IN`: English
- `as-IN`: Assamese
- `ur-IN`: Urdu
- `ne-IN`: Nepali
- `kok-IN`: Konkani
- `ks-IN`: Kashmiri
- `sd-IN`: Sindhi
- `sa-IN`: Sanskrit
- `sat-IN`: Santali
- `mni-IN`: Manipuri
- `brx-IN`: Bodo
- `mai-IN`: Maithili
- `doi-IN`: Dogri
speechToTextStreaming_language-code.title: speechToTextStreaming_language-code

speechToTextStreaming_model.description:
Specifies the model to use for speech-to-text conversion.

- **saaras:v4** (default, recommended, latest): Flexible output formats across all modes (transcribe, translate, verbatim, translit, codemix), supporting Global + Indian English and 22 Indic languages.

- **saaras:v3**: State-of-the-art model with flexible output formats. Supports multiple modes via the `mode` parameter: transcribe, translate, verbatim, translit, codemix.
speechToTextStreaming_model.title: speechToTextStreaming_model

speechToTextStreaming_mode.description:
Mode of operation. **Only applicable when using saaras:v3 or saaras:v4 models.**

Example audio: 'मेरा फोन नंबर है 9840950950'

- **transcribe** (default): Standard transcription in the original language with proper formatting and number normalization.
  - Output: `मेरा फोन नंबर है 9840950950`

- **translate**: Translates speech from any supported Indic language to English.
  - Output: `My phone number is 9840950950`

- **verbatim**: Exact word-for-word transcription without normalization, preserving filler words and spoken numbers as-is.
  - Output: `मेरा फोन नंबर है नौ आठ चार zero नौ पांच zero नौ पांच zero`

- **translit**: Romanization - Transliterates speech to Latin/Roman script only.
  - Output: `mera phone number hai 9840950950`

- **codemix**: Code-mixed text with English words in English and Indic words in native script.
  - Output: `मेरा phone number है 9840950950`
speechToTextStreaming_mode.title: speechToTextStreaming_mode

language_probability.description:
Float value (0.0 to 1.0) indicating the probability of the detected language being correct. Higher values indicate higher confidence.

**When it returns a value:**
- When `language_code` is not provided in the request
- When `language_code` is set to `unknown`

**When it returns null:**
- When a specific `language_code` is provided (language detection is skipped)
